definitions.explanation: A person who serves on the governing board of an organization such as a corporation, university, nonprofit, or international body. Responsible for management decisions and organizational oversight.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{理事|りじ}に{選|えら}ばれた。
examples.english: She was elected as a board member.

examples.japanese: {理事会|りじかい}で{新|あたら}しい{方針|ほうしん}が{決定|けってい}された。
examples.english: A new policy was decided at the board meeting.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{理事|りじ}{長|ちょう}が{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}で{今後|こんご}の{経営|けいえい}{計画|けいかく}について{説明|せつめい}した。
examples.english: The university's chairman of the board explained future management plans at a press conference.

notes:
USAGE:
{理事|りじ} refers to a member of a governing board ({理事会|りじかい}). Used for corporate boards, university boards of trustees, nonprofit organizations, and international organizations such as the UN Security Council ({安全保障理事会|あんぜんほしょうりじかい}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {理事会|りじかい} (board of directors/trustees)
- {理事長|りじちょう} (chairman of the board)
- {常任理事国|じょうにんりじこく} (permanent member of the Security Council)
- {理事|りじ}に{就任|しゅうにん}する (assume a position as director)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {取締役|とりしまりやく}: corporate director (specifically for companies under the Companies Act)
- {役員|やくいん}: executive, officer (broader term for organizational leadership)
- {委員|いいん}: committee member (serves on a committee, not a governing board)
